name: Gathering the Cure
summary: At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem guides young tauren druids through a sacred passage. You gather earthroot and sturdy kodo horns for a salve to treat the poisoned gazelles of the Barrens.

sections.title: A Recipe for Relief
sections.body: Tonga Runetotem needs ingredients for an antidote, using the water sample you secured at Dreadmist Peak. Earthroot gives the salve its medicinal qualities, while ground kodo horn lends it the strength to drive venom from a creature's system. For a young druid, gathering these means relying on the earth's gifts and hunting local beasts.

sections.title: Lessons in Cleansing
sections.body: As Tonga Runetotem prepares the salve, he teaches the limits of physical medicine. Herbal lore and alchemy can counter certain toxins, but most poisons need their own cure. Rather than carry endless herbs and horns, druids learn to attune to nature's healing energies. That lesson leads to the druidic art of Cure Poison.

faq.q: What ingredients does Tonga Runetotem require?
faq.answer: Tonga asks for five bundles of earthroot and five intact kodo horns. Earthroot brings healing properties, while the horns give the salve potency against the toxins harming local gazelles.

faq.q: Where can the kodo horns be found?
faq.answer: Kodos roam the northern and central Barrens, often grazing near roads around the Crossroads. Tonga needs whole, sturdy horns for the salve, not brittle chips.

faq.q: Do I have to be an herbalist to obtain earthroot?
faq.answer: No, you do not need herbalism to get earthroot. Herbalists harvest it from cliffs and rocky outcroppings across the Barrens. Druids who cannot gather it themselves can obtain it from fellow travelers or trading posts.

faq.q: Why is Tonga preparing a physical salve?
faq.answer: Tonga is making a physical antidote for poisoned gazelles suffering across the northern Barrens. The careful work also shows the advantage of innate magical purification spells.
Tonga Runetotem is an elder tauren druid at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He investigates corruption spreading through the region's waterways and guides young druids in mastering nature's balance.

faq.q: What comes after gathering these ingredients?
faq.answer: After Tonga brews the salve, he sends you into the savannah to apply it to afflicted gazelles and test the remedy. Then he teaches the deeper art of magical purification.

angles.text: As a druid, you face trials that teach you to move beyond mortal herbcraft and channel nature's magic to purge venom directly.
As an herbalist, you know the value of gathering wild medicinal roots from the rocky hillsides of the savannah.
As a member of the Horde, you help Tonga protect the wildlife around the Crossroads and preserve a stable ecosystem for the Horde's heartland outpost.
